title: Microsoft Copilot: publish organisation prompts to every user from the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: Hold: the briefing makes Privileged Role Administrator a requirement for every Graph role-assignment call, although Microsoft specifies that requirement for delegated access, not application access. The publishing controls, limits, licensing background and roadmap details are supported; the separate delegated-publishing roadmap assertion could not be verified.

claims.claim: Company-wide prompt publishing lets organisations distribute their own prompt collections to all tenant users.
claims.quote: Organizations can build their own collections of prompts that are tailored to their business needs and workflows and distribute these to all users within the tenant.
